summary: Abits Group Inc, a BVI-incorporated, Hong Kong-based Nasdaq-listed crypto asset firm formerly Moxian (BVI), filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with one institutional investor for a US$16,470,588.24 convertible note priced at up to US$14,000,000, a 15% original issue discount, 13% interest guaranteed for twelve months, and three tranches of US$8.0M, up to US$2.5M and up to US$3.5M conditioned on an F-1, reverse-split authority up to 250:1 and three purchaser director nominees.
